activityPresentation.setupDetail: Assumed personal weekday timetable through the remaining 2026–2027 school year, excluding closures and modified days. Not official Walton schoolwide bell times.
notes: Daily repetition is an authorized assumption, not teacher-confirmed recurrence.
Calendar uses existing Walton 2026-2027.2 snapshots; any classroom modified day is excluded conservatively, including June 15–16 kindergarten endings.
Effective November 23, 2026; planned school-year end June 17, 2027. No snow-day extension assumed.
10:00–10:40 and 11:30–11:50 remain excluded because their labels are unconfirmed.
